description: Register agentic wallet addresses with the wallet service.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

wallets.description: Array of wallet info objects. Each wallet contains walletID and accounts array. Each account contains accountID and chainAddressList array. Each chainAddress contains networkKey, chains, chainAddress, and optional accountKey/accountFormat.

name: dex_agentic_report
